sources.title: Apache Tika 4.1.x Pages: rendering, OCR policy, emitted page images
sources.released_version_or_commit: Versioned documentation line 4.1.x; investigator source S01 records Tika 4.1.0 release. This is a documentation line, not a pinned source commit.
sources.locator: Defaults block; `text` AUTO behavior; request/parser configuration overlay; OCR maxPages and auto thresholds; rendering defaults.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the versioned official documentation and inspected defaults, AUTO recognizer conditions/fallbacks, and configuration overlays.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Default text mode is AUTO; default OCR thresholds are 10 total characters and 10 unmapped Unicode characters per page; maxPages=-1; default render DPI is 300 and maxImagePixels is 100000000. AUTO replaces extracted text only when a configured text recognizer actually writes text; no engine, exhausted page budget, timeout, or error retains the extracted text. A request-level pages block replaces the general config block while parser-specific overlays can persist.
sources.applicability: Confirms exact Tika 4.1.x behavior and defaults, but does not establish which pages an app actually OCR'd, app freshness, or OCR correctness. An adapter must preserve observed per-page provenance; default -1 is not a finite OCR page cap.

sources.title: Apache Tika 4.1.x Security
sources.released_version_or_commit: Versioned documentation line 4.1.x; no patch commit pinned by this page.
sources.locator: In-Process Parsing and Denial of Service; process isolation; heap/timeout; Tika Server and gRPC trust model.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official versioned security page and inspected direct parsing, output-limit scope, forked-JVM isolation, timeout/heap bounds, and service trust conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Direct parser calls run on the caller thread and heap. Output limits bound output, not the work to produce it. Pipes/PipesForkParser and Tika services use forked JVMs where configured; heap ceilings and timeouts are required bounds. Server/gRPC do not authenticate callers and are not security boundaries.
sources.applicability: Supports isolating parsing from the UI and configuring actual time/resource bounds if Tika is selected. Merely using Tika or hosting it locally does not provide those properties.

sources.title: Apache Tika PR #3145 files: TIKA-4883 AUTO OCR fix and release-note diff
sources.released_version_or_commit: PR records fix for Tika 4.1.0; investigator source S11 identifies merge commit bdc72de. The opened release-note diff says Release 4.1.0.
sources.locator: CHANGES.txt diff for TIKA-4883; PDFParserTest appears in changed-file listing; TextRecognizer condition in release/configuration diff.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the upstream PR file diff and searched its release-note and test-file sections for AUTO replacement/fallback conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Poor extracted text is held for AUTO; OCR supersedes it only for a configured text recognizer that actually writes text. Extracted text is released unchanged when OCR cannot run due to absent engine, exhausted page cap, timeout, or error; AUTO without an engine behaves as no OCR.
sources.applicability: Corroborates the parser-specific fix and regression history. Upstream changed tests are not executed validation of this proposed notebook component.

sources.title: SQLite FTS5 Extension reference
sources.released_version_or_commit: Live official SQLite reference, inspected 2026-10-12; no single SQLite release/build pinned.
sources.locator: Unicode61 tokenizer; external-content tables and pitfalls; trigger/backfill behavior; rebuild/integrity-check.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official reference and inspected tokenizer defaults and external-content synchronization requirements.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: unicode61 is the default and is based on Unicode 6.1; default token characters are letter/number/private-use categories, contiguous runs are tokens, and Latin diacritics are removed by default. External-content index/content consistency is caller responsibility; divergence can make query results unintuitive, and triggers do not index rows that predate trigger creation.
sources.applicability: Supports conditional FTS5 baseline and integrity/rebuild tests. It does not guarantee the application's SQLite build includes FTS5 or provide language-aware segmentation/relevance for every writing system.

sources.title: Apache PDFBox 3.0 FAQ
sources.released_version_or_commit: PDFBox documentation line 3.0; FAQ does not pin a patch release.
sources.locator: FAQ: extracted text appears in wrong sequence; image-only scanned PDFs; encrypted text permission.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official FAQ and inspected default text order, optional geometric sorting, and image-only/encrypted document conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Default follows the PDF page content-stream sequence. Geometric left-to-right/top-to-bottom sorting is available with setSortByPosition(true), but PDF is a graphic format without semantic reading-order guarantee. A scanned image may have no selectable text; extraction can also be blocked by permissions/password.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's reading-order, scanned-state, and unknown-locator caveats; locator fidelity must be tested for the selected adapter.
